At Apple, we create intuitive, intelligent experiences that enrich people's lives. We are seeking a Senior Human-Centered AI Researcher to help shape the next generation of software experiences across Apple's ecosystem. In this role, you will lead research that advances our understanding of how people interact with both emerging AI capabilities and established software experiences. Working closely with engineering, design, marketing, data science, and AI/ML modeling teams, you will define research strategies, uncover user needs and expectations, and translate behavioral insights into actionable recommendations that influence product direction, design, quality and ultimately shape the end customer experience.
Our team conducts human-centered research throughout the software and AI-feature development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and expectations to evaluating early prototypes and assessing product experience quality. We combine rigorous qualitative and quantitative methods to understand how people perceive, interact with, and experience software, including intelligent and adaptive systems.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in experimental design, statistical analysis, and mixed-methods research, with the scientific judgment to select and adapt methodologies to complex product questions. You will independently lead research initiatives across multiple product areas, collaborating with cross-functional partners to identify critical research questions, establish meaningful evaluation criteria, and translate findings into actionable product recommendations.
This role requires the ability to communicate complex findings to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and executives, and directly influence product strategy and development priorities. You will also contribute to research strategy, advance methodological practices, and mentor other researchers.
Define and lead human-centered research strategies across multiple software and AI-powered experiences, identifying critical research questions and opportunities to inform product development.
Design and execute rigorous qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods studies, including controlled experiments, surveys, usability evaluations, interviews, longitudinal studies, and Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA).
Apply experimental design principles and appropriate statistical techniques to evaluate user behavior, perceptions, expectations, and experience quality.
Lead research throughout the software and AI-feature development lifecycle, from early user needs and expectations research through prototype evaluation, feature refinement, and product quality assessment.
Develop human-centered evaluation frameworks, experience metrics, and success criteria to assess usability, usefulness, reliability, and perceived quality of software and intelligent systems.
Partner closely with engineering, design, product marketing, data science, and AI/ML modeling teams to align research objectives with product and technical priorities, inform tradeoffs, and guide feature development.
Integrate insights from qualitative research, self-reported measures, experimental data, and behavioral telemetry to develop a comprehensive understanding of user experience.
Translate complex research findings into clear, compelling presentations and recommendations for cross-functional teams, senior leadership, and executives, directly influencing product direction and development decisions.
Provide technical and methodological leadership across multiple projects, mentoring researchers, developing scalable research approaches, and advancing research practices across the organization.
Minimum Qualifications
PhD in Cognitive Science, Experimental Psychology, Neuroscience, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field with substantial training in quantitative and qualitative research.
5+ years of relevant experience conducting human-centered research in technology or software product development.
Formal training and demonstrated expertise in experimental design, including hypothesis development, study design, sampling strategies, randomization, measurement, and interpretation of experimental results.
Strong proficiency in statistics including t-tests, analysis of variance (ANOVA), regression models, clustering techniques, factor analysis, mixed-effects models, repeated-measures analysis, or other multivariate approaches with the ability to select, apply, and interpret appropriate analyses for complex research questions.
Demonstrated expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including survey design, usability testing, Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA), diary studies, field experiments, or other longitudinal and in-situ research programs.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools and workflows across the research lifecycle, including but not limited to research design, data processing, qualitative and quantitative analysis, and synthesis of findings, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and validity.
Experience researching AI-powered products, generative AI, intelligent systems, or emerging software interaction paradigms.
Experience combining behavioral telemetry, self-reported measures, and qualitative findings to inform product decisions.
Proven ability to translate complex research findings into actionable recommendations and communicate effectively through presentations to senior leadership and executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy, navigate ambiguous research questions, and provide methodological mentorship to other researchers.

Apple Services Engineering (ASE), the team behind iCloud and Media services and the infrastructure that powers them, is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to partner with engineering teams to build AI-driven security assurance capabilities. You will collaborate with developers, site reliability engineers, and security teams to protect ASE services and design a secure foundation for services at Apple. Your work will include scaling assurance activities, including security risk assessments, threat modeling, and development of security standards. You will work with partner teams in security engineering, privacy, and offensive security to keep Apple's services secure for our users. If you love diving into complex technical systems, sharing security improvements, and making security better, we want to hear from you!
In this role, you will combine deep expertise in security architecture, threat modeling, security design review, and spec-driven development (SDD) with hands-on experience building sophisticated AI-powered systems. You will design and develop intelligent security assurance capabilities that leverage large language models, autonomous agents, and build organization–specific security context to identify and prevent meaningful security risk across complex systems and architectures.
You will also help define how security is incorporated into SDD practices, ensuring that security requirements, threat models, abuse cases, trust boundaries, controls, and verification criteria are established early and carried through the specification, implementation, testing, and development lifecycle.
This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of security assurance and applied-AI. You will partner closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams working at the forefront of agent technology, to understand emerging capabilities, influence how agentic systems are designed and developed, and integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Architect, develop, and deploy AI-powered security assurance systems that automate and augment security design reviews, threat modeling, and architectural risk assessments
Define and implement security practices for spec-driven development, including security requirements, abuse cases, threat models, trust boundaries, control objectives, and security acceptance criteria
Integrate security analysis and verification into the SDD lifecycle so that security considerations are addressed during specification, design, implementation, testing, and change review
Build agentic workflows capable of analyzing complex system architectures and specifications, reasoning about security threats, identifying potential vulnerabilities, and producing actionable security findings
Implement advanced context-management approaches, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), persistent agent memory, and other techniques that enable AI systems to reason effectively within the organization's security environment
Apply evaluation frameworks to measure the accuracy, completeness, reliability, and security effectiveness of AI-generated assessments and SDD outputs
Integrate AI-driven assurance capabilities into engineering workflows and existing security infrastructure to expand security coverage without proportionally increasing manual review effort
Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, agent frameworks, and engineering techniques, identifying opportunities to improve security assurance capabilities
Partner with security engineers, architects, and engineering teams to translate complex security requirements and expert judgment into reusable, automated assurance capabilities
Minimum Qualifications
10 or more years of hands-on experience in security assurance, with demonstrated depth in security architecture, threat modeling, security design reviews, and security risk assessment.
Experience evaluating AI system performance, including reliability, correctness, failure, modes, and effectiveness against defined objectives.
Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language, API integration, and production software development.
Experience with LLM orchestration, agent tool use, retrieval systems, context engineering, and techniques for grounding AI outputs in trusted organizational data.
Experience incorporating security into spec-driven development, requirements engineering, secure design practices, or comparable structured software development methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
Experience applying generative AI or agentic automation specific to security assurance, threat, modeling, architecture, reviews, vulnerability analysis, or spec-driven development.
Experience building enterprise knowledge systems using RAG, knowledge graphs, persistent memory, or hybrid retrieval techniques.
Experience in integrating AI agents with engineering tools, source code, repositories, architecture, documentation, specifications, requirements systems, and security assessment workflows.
Experience establishing traceability between specifications, security requirements, implementation artifacts, tests, and assurance evidence.

The Video Computer Vision (VCV) organization is an applied research and engineering team developing next-generation multimodal intelligence technologies across Apple products. Within VCV, our team builds intelligent systems that combine multimodal understanding, reasoning, and tool use to deliver compelling user experiences. Our work is deeply integrated into the Apple ecosystem, partnering across hardware, software, and ML teams to deliver real-time, scalable, and privacy-preserving experiences reaching millions of users.
In this role, you will develop post-training methods that turn foundation models into capable, reliable, and efficient agents for on-device execution. You will develop supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning methods for agentic models, alongside the training data, interactive environments, reward signals, and evaluations needed to advance reasoning, tool use, and long-horizon tasks. A central research challenge is enabling smaller models to make effective decisions and complete multi-step tasks within tight latency, memory, and energy budgets. You will investigate how to improve reasoning, planning, and tool use while reducing reliance on lengthy generated reasoning and large inference budgets. Research directions may include structured reasoning, adaptive computation, and training objectives that balance task success with computational cost. You will own the projects end to end: identify capability gaps, formulate hypotheses, build training pipelines, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate frontier research into Apple products that deliver meaningful value to users.
Advance agentic post-training for on-device models. Develop supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, preference optimization, and distillation methods that improve reasoning and multi-step tool use in on-device LLMs.
Design training data and interactive environments. Build scalable pipelines for trajectory generation, curriculum construction, and hard-example mining. Develop environments that support learning through tool use and multimodal interaction.
Design reward functions, verifiers, and graders for complex agent tasks, addressing long-horizon credit assignment, supervision quality, and gaps between reward scores and actual task success.
Improve capability under deployment constraints. Research methods that balance task success with latency, memory, energy, and tool-use costs, including structured or compressed reasoning and adaptive computation.
Build rigorous evaluations and diagnostics. Measure task success, generalization, reliability, and efficiency. Analyze model outputs and agent trajectories to distinguish modeling limitations from data, reward, environment, and infrastructure issues, and turn findings into targeted improvements.
Translate research into Apple experiences. Collaborate with software and hardware teams to integrate and validate agent capabilities under realistic on-device constraints.
Drive external research impact. Contribute to research projects from initial hypothesis through experimental validation, publish high-impact technical reports as a core author, and release open-source models that advance agentic post-training and support the broader research community. Example technical reports: “Internalized Visual Thinking for Video Reasoning, Structured Reasoning for Efficient Agentic Search.”
Minimum Qualifications
MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
A strong research track record demonstrated by either first-author publications at top-tier conferences (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ACL, or EMNLP) or substantial hands-on experience training frontier models, with contributions relevant to foundation models, reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, or agentic systems.
Strong programming skills in Python and proficiency with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
Demonstrated ability to formulate research hypotheses, implement training and evaluation pipelines, conduct controlled experiments, and draw well-supported conclusions.
Preferred Qualifications
PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Research focus on foundation models, reinforcement learning, agentic systems, multimodal reasoning, or efficient machine learning.
Significant contributions to high-impact technical reports or open-source model releases in agentic post-training, with substantial ownership of research methodology, model training, experimental validation, and technical communication.
Experience developing or training agents for tool use and long-horizon tasks.
Experience designing interactive training environments, trajectory-generation pipelines, reward models, or scalable agent evaluations.
Experience improving smaller models through compute-aware post-training, with an understanding of on-device latency, memory, and energy constraints.

Success in this role requires strong self-motivation, crisp and clear communication, a highly collaborative approach, and the ability to define and influence engineering strategy well beyond your own team.

Lead large, multi-quarter engineering efforts — including complex integrations with financial institution and payment network partners — from conception through production
Drive technical discussions across teams and organizations, authoring specifications and representing Apple in external partner negotiations
